agent_run_timestamps_check.name: agent_run_timestamps_check
agent_run_timestamps_check.value:
(
      ("agent_run"."status" = 'queued' and "agent_run"."started_at" is null and "agent_run"."settled_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run"."status" = 'running' and "agent_run"."started_at" is not null and "agent_run"."settled_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'aborted', 'interrupted') and "agent_run"."settled_at" is not null)
    )

agent_run_completed_check.name: agent_run_completed_check
agent_run_completed_check.value:
"agent_run"."status" != 'completed' or (
      "agent_run"."assistant_message_id" is not null and "agent_run"."config_snapshot" is not null
      and "agent_run"."started_at" is not null and "agent_run"."stop_reason" is not null and "agent_run"."stop_reason" = 'stop'
      and "agent_run"."error_code" is null and "agent_run"."error_message" is null
    )

agent_run_failed_check.name: agent_run_failed_check

agent_run_input_disposition_check.name: agent_run_input_disposition_check
agent_run_input_disposition_check.value:
(
      ("agent_run_input"."disposition" = 'pending' and "agent_run_input"."delivered_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run_input"."disposition" = 'delivered' and "agent_run_input"."delivered_at" is not null)
    )

chat_title_check.name: chat_title_check
chat_title_check.value: "chat"."title" is null or length(trim("chat"."title")) between 1 and 80

directory_observation_result_check.name: directory_observation_result_check
directory_observation_result_check.value: ("directory_observation"."kind" = 'accessible' and "directory_observation"."real_path" is not null and "directory_observation"."reason" is null and length("directory_observation"."real_path") between 1 and 4096 and substr("directory_observation"."real_path", 1, 1) = '/' and instr("directory_observation"."real_path", char(0)) = 0) or ("directory_observation"."kind" = 'unavailable' and "directory_observation"."real_path" is null and "directory_observation"."reason" is not null and "directory_observation"."reason" in ('missing', 'not_directory', 'denied', 'io_error'))

execution_result_check_3.name: execution_result_check_3
execution_result_check_3.value: CASE WHEN json_valid(payload_json) THEN json_type(payload_json)='object' ELSE 0 END

lease_authorization_check_9.name: lease_authorization_check_9
lease_authorization_check_9.value:
(state='free' AND holder_instance_id IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR
        (state IN ('active','draining') AND holder_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR
        (state='revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND typeof(revoked_at)='integer' AND revoked_at>=issued_at)

lease_mutation_check_12.name: lease_mutation_check_12
lease_mutation_check_12.value: (action='handoff' AND target_instance_id IS NOT NULL) OR (action!='handoff' AND target_instance_id IS NULL)

lease_mutation_check_13.name: lease_mutation_check_13
lease_mutation_check_13.value: (actor_kind='agent' AND action IN ('acquire','release','handoff')) OR (actor_kind='human' AND action='reclaim')

lease_mutation_check_14.name: lease_mutation_check_14
lease_mutation_check_14.value:
(state='pending' AND action!='acquire' AND completed_at IS NULL AND completed_generation IS NULL) OR
        (state='completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND typeof(completed_at)='integer' AND completed_at>=created_at
          AND completed_generation IS NOT NULL AND typeof(completed_generation)='integer'
          AND completed_generation BETWEEN expected_generation AND 9007199254740991)

machine_root_directory_check.name: machine_root_directory_check
machine_root_directory_check.value: "machine"."root_directory" is null or (length("machine"."root_directory") between 1 and 4096 and substr("machine"."root_directory", 1, 1) = '/' and instr("machine"."root_directory", char(0)) = 0)

machine_connection_status_check.name: machine_connection_status_check
machine_connection_status_check.value: ("machine_connection"."status" = 'open' and "machine_connection"."closed_at" is null) or ("machine_connection"."status" = 'closed' and "machine_connection"."closed_at" is not null)

machine_connection_payload_check.name: machine_connection_payload_check
machine_connection_payload_check.value: ("machine_connection"."seq" = 0 and "machine_connection"."capability" is null and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" is null) or ("machine_connection"."seq" > 0 and "machine_connection"."capability" is not null and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" is not null and length("machine_connection"."last_payload_hash") = 64 and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

machine_capability_json_check.name: machine_capability_json_check
machine_capability_json_check.value: case when "machine_connection"."capability" is null then 1 when json_valid("machine_connection"."capability") then json_type("machine_connection"."capability") = 'object' else 0 end

machine_secret_hash_check.name: machine_secret_hash_check
machine_secret_hash_check.value: "machine_credential"."secret_hash" is null or (length("machine_credential"."secret_hash") = 64 and "machine_credential"."secret_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

machine_activation_check.name: machine_activation_check
machine_activation_check.value: ("machine_credential"."secret_hash" is null and "machine_credential"."activated_at" is null) or ("machine_credential"."secret_hash" is not null and "machine_credential"."activated_at" is not null)

machine_lease_check_7.name: machine_lease_check_7
machine_lease_check_7.value:
(state='free' AND holder_instance_id IS NULL) OR
        (state IN ('held','fencing') AND holder_instance_id IS NOT NULL)

remote_execution_check_3.name: remote_execution_check_3
remote_execution_check_3.value: CASE WHEN json_valid(operation_json) THEN json_type(operation_json)='object' ELSE 0 END

remote_execution_check_4.name: remote_execution_check_4
remote_execution_check_4.value: directory_revision IS NULL OR (typeof(directory_revision)='integer' AND directory_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991)

remote_execution_check_14.name: remote_execution_check_14
remote_execution_check_14.value:
(dispatch_connection_generation IS NULL AND dispatch_seq IS NULL AND dispatched_at IS NULL AND drained_at IS NULL) OR
        (dispatch_connection_generation IS NOT NULL AND typeof(dispatch_connection_generation)='integer' AND dispatch_connection_generation>=1
          AND dispatch_seq IS NOT NULL AND typeof(dispatch_seq)='integer' AND dispatch_seq>=1
          AND dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND typeof(dispatched_at)='integer' AND dispatched_at>=created_at)

remote_execution_check_15.name: remote_execution_check_15
remote_execution_check_15.value: drained_at IS NULL OR (typeof(drained_at)='integer' AND dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND drained_at>=dispatched_at)

remote_execution_check_16.name: remote_execution_check_16
remote_execution_check_16.value: state NOT IN ('dispatched','running','draining') OR dispatch_connection_generation IS NOT NULL

remote_execution_check_18.name: remote_execution_check_18
remote_execution_check_18.value: state!='succeeded' OR (dispatch_connection_generation IS NOT NULL AND drained_at IS NOT NULL)

remote_execution_check_19.name: remote_execution_check_19
remote_execution_check_19.value:
(state IN ('queued','dispatched','running','draining') AND terminal_at IS NULL AND failure_reason IS NULL) OR
        (state='succeeded' AND terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND typeof(terminal_at)='integer' AND terminal_at>=created_at AND failure_reason IS NULL) OR
        (state IN ('failed','rejected','timed_out','unknown') AND terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND typeof(terminal_at)='integer' AND terminal_at>=created_at AND failure_reason IS NOT NULL)

remote_tool_grant_check_6.name: remote_tool_grant_check_6
remote_tool_grant_check_6.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR (typeof(revoked_at)='integer' AND revoked_at>=issued_at)

worker_exchange_frame_check_4.name: worker_exchange_frame_check_4
worker_exchange_frame_check_4.value: CASE WHEN json_valid(response_json) THEN json_type(response_json)='object' ELSE 0 END
